label_cost_unit: one queried camera-image label per official sample
classes_confirmatory: remaining Real-IAD categories and MVTec-AD, no tuning

stream.random_definition: sample shuffle per phase, cameras C1..C5 consecutive; no labels read
stream.stress_definition: offline any-defect-visible sample grouping within each phase; synthetic, non-deployable
stream.acquisition_definition: phase-blocked capture-timestamp order from D1-A; not globally chronological

q_b.reference: frozen static support scorer, same initial LOSO theta0
q_b.first_query_opportunity: C1 arrival of each official sample; one query maximum
q_b.normalization: delta=max(1e-6, MAD of support-only LOSO normal scores)
q_b.random_draw: separate deterministic hashed U(0,1) per sample and query seed
q_b.spent_budget_handling: cap B; no future-label backfill; report unspent B
prohibited: raw label-bearing filename/sample key to controller
q_b.warning: causal prospective rule, unlike offline preselected Q-A tape

q_c.comparison: cap-matched AIF-inspired vs random query controller

threshold.T0: fixed theta0 derived from support-only LOSO
threshold.T2: future confidence-sequence sidecar, outside current freeze

ablation.C_off: disable signed correction; retain defect-anchor ledger
ablation.Q_off: random query at same budget cap, not zero feedback

prequential_order: trusted adapter loads opaque observation; raw scorer predicts
controller decides query using only pre-feedback state
if queried reveal only that image-view label
verified-normal proposal evaluated against strictly prior anchors
after admission, append current label to ledgers and update optional components
evaluate holdout probes without exposing their labels to online controller

priority_execution.D1B: six classes/3 query seeds/5 orders/4 primary budgets: metadata only
priority_execution.D2_primary: run paired Q-A admission arms under random mode first
priority_execution.D4: shared Q-B informative tape smoke; no retroactive tuning
priority_execution.D5: stress orders and auxiliary high-budget conditions
priority_execution.D6: Q-C native AIF factorial after module isolation

scope: metadata protocol registration only; no GPU, no CDARG, no Q-B/Q-C execution
